summary: Full backend + frontend testing of the new dynamic 'Technologies We Teach' feature (public endpoint, admin CRUD, reorder, deactivate, presentation settings, live preview) plus regression smoke of core public endpoints. Backend: 15/15 feature tests passed. Frontend: admin page loads, all 8 presentation data-testids present, 11 seeded techs listed, add/toggle/delete/preview/save all work and persist. Homepage renders technologies-section with 5 cards on Saturday, no weekday names leaked to public, existing sections intact, no mobile horizontal overflow. Post-test state restored (Float defaults, all 11 techs reactivated).

issues: Some seed icon_url values (AWS 'amazonwebservices', Windows 'windows11' from cdn.simpleicons.org) 404 — code falls back gracefully to colored monogram badge as designed; consider swapping to valid slugs (e.g., 'amazonaws', 'windows') to remove console 404 noise.

action_items: Optional: fix seed icon slugs to eliminate cdn.simpleicons.org 404s (AWS -> amazonaws, Windows -> windows). Not a blocker.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py exceeds 1500 lines — consider splitting into routers (public, admin, payments, technologies) for maintainability.
Public /api/technologies correctly excludes _id and filters inactive; day filter is correct with fallback when nothing matches for the day.
Presentation settings correctly merged with defaults on read; PUT /admin/settings accepts arbitrary keys via generic setting handler.

success_rate.backend: 100% (15/15 feature; 1 unrelated regression path /students returns 404 by design as it's admin-only)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (admin CRUD, reorder, toggle, delete, preview, save; public render + responsive)

seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed technologies and clean them up. Post-run state restored: presentation reset to Float/5/left/150/true/3d-tilt; all 11 seed techs reactivated.
